_about: Public-domain Henry Scadding (1813-1901), rector of Holy Trinity, Toronto, and antiquarian, for the Word Hoard: his church addresses and memorials (William Honywood Ripley, Cleanliness akin to Godliness, A Dead Christendom Reviving, English Civilization Undemonstrative, Christian Pantheism, Truth's Resurrections, The First Bishop of Toronto, To the Choirs of Holy Trinity, On a Sung Service) and his history Toronto of Old. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 116 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

scadding-ripley: A memorial of the Reverend William Honywood Ripley, Bachelor of Arts of University College ... of the Diocese of Toronto : (being, with additions and notes, the sermon preached in Trinity Church ... the 21st Sunday after Trinity, and the Festival of St. Simon and St. Jude, October the 28th, 1849) ([Toronto? : s.n.], 1849)
scadding-dead-christendom: A dead Christendom reviving : a lecture delivered in the Church of the Holy Trinity, Toronto, on the day of public thanksgiving for the restoration of peace, (Wednesday, June 4th, 1856) (Toronto : Maclear, 1856)
scadding-english-civilization: English civilization undemonstrative : the address to the St. George's Society, in the Cathedral of St. James, Toronto, April 23rd, 1860 (Toronto : Rowsell & Hutchinson, 1860)
scadding-christian-pantheism: Christian pantheism : an address on Thanksgiving Day, 1865 (Toronto : Rollo & Adam, 1865)
scadding-truths-resurrections: Truth's resurrections : a memorial of Easter, 1865 (Toronto : Rollo & Adam, 1865)
scadding-first-bishop: The first bishop of Toronto : a review and a study (Toronto : W. C. Chewett, 1868)
scadding-choirs: To the choirs of the church and parish of the Holy Trinity, Toronto ([Toronto? : s.n.], 1871)
scadding-sung-service: On a sung service and its appurtenances : a lecture, delivered on the occasion of the first use of the organ, after reconstruction, in the Church of the Holy Trinity, Toronto, October 27, 1874 ([S.l. : s.n., 1874)
scadding-toronto-of-old: Toronto of old; collections and recollections illustrative of the early settlement and social life of the capital of Ontario (Toronto, Adam, Stevenson & co., 1873)

_excluded.scadding-antiquarian: His many short antiquarian, numismatic and local-history papers are left to another lane; books he only owned or introduced (Pope, Horace, Franklin, Traill) are not his
